title: The EU DPP Registry is live: enrolment and verification in plain steps
subtitle: The draft we asked the Commission to sharpen is now adopted as CIR (EU) 2026/1778, and the Registry went live on 20 July 2026. Here is the official User Guide, condensed into the steps an economic operator actually takes.
featuredImageAlt: The EU DPP Registry, live in production: the verification, lookup and log spine connecting Europe's product-regulation regimes
excerpt: The EU DPP Registry is live in production since 20 July 2026, governed by Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/1778. Here is the Commission's User Guide for Economic Operators condensed into plain steps: EU Login, enrolment, the seven-step verification, and passport registration.
